title: 个人持续使用与发布裁决

task_matrix.boundary: The selected repository was unrelated to Conflux-Weave; the delivery explicitly retained this mismatch and cannot support the requested project claim.

task_matrix.failure: GitHub search returned no valid candidates

browser_audit.runtime: temporary Playwright driving installed Microsoft Edge

useful_deliveries.note: Both were partial; repository delivery was irrelevant to the requested project.

reasons: Only one of the required two successful Workbench golden paths completed.
Three of five frozen tasks failed, including two arXiv HTTP 429 failures.
Repository discovery selected an unrelated repository for one task and no candidate for the other.
No delivery has an explicit user confirmation of use in notes, review, experiment or project decision.
required_before_re_admission: Define a source-rate policy that respects arXiv limits without automatic retrying an unknown external effect.
Freeze repository queries with identity constraints and validate candidate relevance before Provider generation.
Repeat a new five-task audit without counting these failed or partial tasks again.
Obtain explicit user confirmation that at least one delivery was used for real work.

evidence_boundary: W5.7 proves a bounded five-task personal-use attempt and a negative release decision. It does not prove sustained reliability, general repository research, production readiness or publication readiness. Failed and irrelevant results are retained and are not counted as success.
